title: Crunchyroll’s Fullmetal Alchemist Successor Is Ending First Season by Proving It’s a Worthy Heir
content: Fullmetal Alchemist has emerged as one of the timeless anime masterpieces, with no other anime ever able to compete with what this masterpiece presents. It was a perfect story featuring family bonds, war, and political conflict, with sci-fi elements that made it perfect through and through.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll’s Darkest Anime of 2026 Creator Breaks Silence on Finale
content: As September is the last month of the summer season, new anime that began airing this season are now coming to an end as well. title: A Returner's Magic Should Be Special Season 2's New Video Reveals October 7 Debut
content: The official website for the second anime season based on Wookjakga 's A Returner's Magic Should Be Special ( Kikansha no Mahō wa Tokubetsu Desu in Japanese) Korean webtoon revealed on Tuesday the anime's second promotional video, main key visual, and October 7 premiere.

title: Katekyo Hitman Reborn! Reveals Fifth Opening Featuing "last cross" by Masami Mitsuoka
content: Katekyo Hitman REBORN! anime has officially released the creditless version of its fifth opening, featuring the song “last cross” by Masami Mitsuoka. The song was used in Episodes 102-126, while the new video was released as part of the series’ 20th anniversary celebration.
author: Anime Corner

title: 'Kyouran Reijou Nia Liston' Announces Additional Cast Pair
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Umikaze Minamino 's Kyouran Reijou Nia Liston: Byoujaku Reijou ni Tensei shita Kamigoroshi no Bujin no Karei naru Musouroku ( Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden ) light novel unveiled additional cast pair and situational visual (pictured above) on Tuesday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden Anime Adds 2 More Cast Members
content: The staff for the television anime of Umikaze Minamino 's Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden ( Kyōran Reijō Nia Liston: Byōjaku Reijō ni Tenseishita Kami-goroshi no Bujin no Kareinaru Musō Roku ) light novel series revealed the anime's second "situation visual" and two additional cast members on Tuesday.
author: ANN

title: Ace of Diamond Act II Second Season's 2nd Part Unveils Theme Songs in New Video
content: The staff for Ace of Diamond Act II Second Season , the sequel to the 2019-2020 anime of Yūji Terajima 's Ace of Diamond Act II ( Daiya no A Act II ) manga, started streaming the main promotional video and announced the theme songs for the anime's second cours (quarter of a year) on Tuesday.
author: ANN

title: Julius Faces Reid Again in Re:ZERO Season 4 Episode 17 Preview
content: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 4 has revealed the Episode 17 (Episode 83 overall) preview ahead of its September 16, 2026 premiere. This will be the sixth episode of the second cour, which is subtitled The Recapture Arc .
author: Anime Corner

title: Jujutsu Kaisen Rumble: Survivaton Game Delayed to 2027
content: The staff for Shueisha Games and poncle's Jujutsu Kaisen Rumble: Survivaton game announced on Tuesday that the game's release has been delayed to 2027. The game's staff said that the delay is to delivery a satisfying game. The game also started streaming a second trailer with the new 2027 release date.
author: ANN
